name: Helicoptea
description: Fly tiny helicopters around a cosy kitchen, dangling tea bags into cups. Three.js + Rapier browser game.

paragraphs: Windows browser QA and captures use the shared tools/browser-safety.mjs launcher to prevent headless Chromium from trapping the real desktop pointer. Native mouse-capture acceptance is explicitly skipped on Windows; run it on an isolated Linux runner. Verify the guard with node --test tests/browser-safety-checks.mjs. See pointer incident and recovery.

Reusable development reference: AI game iteration research and overnight improvement playbook and prompts. These cover evidence, quality gates and handoffs for this and future games; no overnight runner is scheduled by these documents.
The bounded 14–15 October overnight polish pass records its starting build, accepted fixes, before/after evidence, recovery steps and hardware limitations.
